summary: passed=9 failed=0 flaky=0 blocked=0 test_error=0, across 9 artifacts for 6 matrix criteria (3 new backend test files = 11 pytest cases, 6 browser checks). No bugs found. Removed one stale pre-existing backend test file (test_tscheck_admin_analytics.py) that asserted the OLD /admin/summary shape (funnel/engagement keys) which the app has since replaced with the new Studio schema (viral_funnel/headline/monetization/unit_economics) — superseded by the new test_tscheck_studio_auth.py / test_tscheck_studio_range_control.py.

action_items.detail: backend/tests/test_tscheck_rate_limit_wall.py::test_fourth_submission_hits_daily_wall failed on this run (got 200 instead of 429) because it depends on a shared, cross-iteration daily submission quota (3/day/IP) already being exhausted by an earlier full-story-discovery-flow browser run. This criterion is not part of the current briefing's acceptance_matrix, so it was left untouched and is not counted in this iteration's checks[]; it is flaky-by-design against shared external quota state, not a regression from this iteration's changes.

checks.criterion: No public link to Studio; old path hidden
checks.name: studio-link-hidden-and-admin-redirects
checks.evidence: On / with tour pre-dismissed, [data-testid=admin-dashboard-link] has 0 count anywhere on the landing page. Navigating to /admin resolves to pathname '/' (client-side redirect via the catch-all <Navigate to="/" replace> route). Navigating to an arbitrary unknown path /some-random-unknown-path-xyz also resolves to '/'. Screenshots: landing-no-studio-link, admin-path-redirected.

checks.criterion: Studio at unlisted path behind password
checks.name: studio-login-password-gate-and-persistence
checks.evidence: /studio-hyapz2ohg7 renders admin-login-page. Wrong password ('tscheck-wrong-password') -> toast 'That studio password did not work.' and login page stays. Correct password 'Aaspaas-admin-2026!' -> admin-dashboard-page visible. page.reload() keeps admin-dashboard-page visible (httpOnly cookie persists session). No console 401s observed once past the deliberate wrong-password attempt (that single expected 401 was excluded from the tracked window).

checks.criterion: Studio at unlisted path behind password (API: session/summary auth)
checks.name: test_tscheck_studio_auth.py
checks.evidence: GET /admin/session (no cookie) -> 200 {authenticated:false}. GET /admin/summary (no cookie) -> 401. POST /admin/login wrong password -> 401. POST /admin/login 'Aaspaas-admin-2026!' -> 200 {authenticated:true} + Set-Cookie aaspaas_admin; subsequent GET /admin/session -> {authenticated:true}; GET /admin/summary?days=30 -> 200 with range_days=30, headline[], viral_funnel[] present. GET /admin/summary?days=5 (authed) -> 422. 5/5 tests passed.

checks.criterion: Studio range control and virality metrics
checks.name: studio-range-control-and-virality-metrics
checks.evidence: Dashboard shows studio-k-factor, studio-biggest-leak, 6 studio-headline metric cards, 7 studio-viral-funnel rows, studio-chain-depth, channel table (or empty-state), studio-preview-platforms, studio-acquisition-trend. studio-range-30d starts aria-pressed=true; clicking studio-range-7d/90d/all each fires GET /api/admin/summary?days=7|90|0 (asserted 200 via waitForResponse) and flips aria-pressed on the clicked button while the previous one resets to false.

checks.criterion: Studio range control and virality metrics (API: days validation + payload shape)
checks.name: test_tscheck_studio_range_control.py
checks.evidence: Authenticated GET /admin/summary?days=X for X in (7,30,90,0) each -> 200 with body.range_days==X, len(viral_funnel)==7, headline non-empty, and channels/preview_platforms/acquisition_trend/top_spreading/monetization/unit_economics/power_users all present. GET /admin/summary?days=5 -> 422. 2/2 tests passed.

checks.name: studio-monetisation-and-unit-economics
checks.evidence: studio-monetization section shows limit_hits/plus_interest/broker_interest/email_list/power_users/paid_intent metric tiles. Power-users table (when non-empty) has first-column labels matching ^visitor·[0-9a-f]{6}$ only (no raw session ids, no '@' / emails). studio-unit-economics section shows ai_cost/cost_per_idea/cost_per_engaged/cost_per_share/viral_cac/fallback_rate/generation tiles.

checks.criterion: Share menu with channel-tagged referral links
checks.name: share-menu-channel-tagged-links
checks.evidence: Ran against the public ingress URL. On /?idea=46aba722...&shared=1, share-chart-button opens a menu with whatsapp/x/copy/image items. Clicking WhatsApp opens a popup whose (decoded) URL matches /api/share/46aba722...\?.*ch=whatsapp and contains ref=<12 hex>, and concurrently fires POST /api/shares with {surface:'chart', channel:'whatsapp'} -> 200. After wrapping up to the recap, share-idea-button's menu Post-on-X click opens a popup matching ch=x + a 12-hex ref and fires POST /api/shares {surface:'recap', channel:'x'} -> 200.

checks.name: test_tscheck_referral_attribution.py
checks.evidence: GET /share-token -> 200, token is 12 hex chars. GET /share/46aba722...?ref=tscheck12345&ch=whatsapp with a real-browser UA -> 200 HTML containing og:image/twitter:card and sets the aaspaas_session cookie (new visitor would be counted in Studio). Same request with UA 'WhatsApp/2.24 A' (crawler) -> 200 HTML but does NOT set aaspaas_session (counted only as a link-preview platform fetch, never as a visitor). GET /share/tscheck-does-not-exist -> 404. 4/4 tests passed.
